SK9097 Arrange-and-format did not reach a fixed point

The arrange-and-format pipeline still wanted to change the file after four passes, so the file was left untouched.

CategoryTool
Default severityerror
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

Arranging and formatting are one operation and each feeds the other, so the property that has to hold is pipeline(pipeline(x)) == pipeline(x). MaxPasses is a bound that reports rather than a net that hides: reaching it means a rule and the formatter disagree about this file. Measured over corpus/real/, the observed maximum is 2 — one pass to arrange and format, one to prove nothing more wants to change.

When it does not fire

None. A finding here is a bug in Skala, and the conformance suite fails on any corpus file that does not converge.
